Use letters, digits, - and _ only; the n.fr: Utilisez uniquement des lettres, des chiffres, - et _ ; le nom entre dans la composition des noms de tables de routage.
Use letters, digits, - and _ only; the n.de: Verwenden Sie nur Buchstaben, Ziffern, - und _; der Name wird Teil der Routing-Tabellennamen.
Use letters, digits, - and _ only; the n.id: Gunakan hanya huruf, angka, - dan _; nama menjadi bagian dari nama routing table.

Use letters, digits, - and _ only; the n.vi: Chỉ dùng chữ cái, chữ số, - và _; tên sẽ trở thành một phần của tên bảng định tuyến.
Use letters, digits, - and _ only; the n.ru: Используйте только буквы, цифры, - и _: имя становится частью названий таблиц маршрутизации.
Use letters, digits, - and _ only; the n.pl: Używaj tylko liter, cyfr oraz znaków - i _; nazwa staje się częścią nazw tablic routingu.
Use letters, digits, - and _ only; the n.hi: सिर्फ़ अक्षर, अंक, - और _ इस्तेमाल करें; नाम रूटिंग टेबल के नामों का हिस्सा बनता है।

Each WAN needs its own value here..pt-BR: Cada WAN precisa de um valor próprio aqui.
Each WAN needs its own value here..fr: Chaque WAN a besoin de sa propre valeur ici.
Each WAN needs its own value here..de: Jedes WAN braucht hier einen eigenen Wert.
Each WAN needs its own value here..id: Setiap WAN memerlukan nilainya sendiri di sini.
Each WAN needs its own value here..it: Ogni WAN richiede un valore diverso.
Each WAN needs its own value here..tr: Her WAN için burada farklı bir değer gerekir.
Each WAN needs its own value here..vi: Mỗi WAN cần một giá trị riêng ở đây.

Use a public address that answers ping,.es: Usa una dirección pública que responda ping, como 1.1.1.1 o 9.9.9.9.
Use a public address that answers ping,.pt-BR: Use um endereço público que responda a ping, como 1.1.1.1 ou 9.9.9.9.
Use a public address that answers ping,.fr: Utilisez une adresse publique qui répond au ping, comme 1.1.1.1 ou 9.9.9.9.
Use a public address that answers ping,.de: Verwenden Sie eine öffentliche Adresse, die auf Ping antwortet, etwa 1.1.1.1 oder 9.9.9.9.
Use a public address that answers ping,.id: Gunakan alamat publik yang membalas ping, seperti 1.1.1.1 atau 9.9.9.9.
Use a public address that answers ping,.it: Usa un indirizzo pubblico che risponde al ping, come 1.1.1.1 o 9.9.9.9.
Use a public address that answers ping,.tr: 1.1.1.1 veya 9.9.9.9 gibi ping'e yanıt veren bir genel adres kullanın.
Use a public address that answers ping,.vi: Hãy dùng một địa chỉ công khai có phản hồi ping, chẳng hạn 1.1.1.1 hoặc 9.9.9.9.
Use a public address that answers ping,.ru: Используйте публичный адрес, отвечающий на ping, например 1.1.1.1 или 9.9.9.9.
Use a public address that answers ping,.pl: Użyj adresu publicznego, który odpowiada na ping, na przykład 1.1.1.1 lub 9.9.9.9.
Use a public address that answers ping,.hi: ऐसा पब्लिक पता इस्तेमाल करें जो ping का जवाब देता हो, जैसे 1.1.1.1 या 9.9.9.9।

FastTrack is still on: fasttracked packe.es: FastTrack sigue activo: los paquetes con fasttrack se saltan las marcas de enrutamiento y pueden salir por la WAN equivocada.
FastTrack is still on: fasttracked packe.pt-BR: O FastTrack ainda está ligado: os pacotes com fasttrack pulam as routing marks e podem sair pela WAN errada.
FastTrack is still on: fasttracked packe.fr: FastTrack est toujours activé : les paquets en fasttrack contournent les marques de routage et peuvent sortir par le mauvais WAN.
FastTrack is still on: fasttracked packe.de: FastTrack ist noch an: FastTrack-Pakete überspringen die Routing-Marks und können über das falsche WAN hinausgehen.
FastTrack is still on: fasttracked packe.id: FastTrack masih aktif: paket yang di-fasttrack melewati routing mark dan bisa keluar lewat WAN yang salah.
FastTrack is still on: fasttracked packe.it: FastTrack è ancora attivo: i pacchetti in fasttrack saltano i routing mark e possono uscire dalla WAN sbagliata.
FastTrack is still on: fasttracked packe.tr: FastTrack hâlâ açık: fasttrack paketler yönlendirme işaretlerini atlar ve yanlış WAN'dan çıkabilir.
FastTrack is still on: fasttracked packe.vi: FastTrack vẫn đang bật: các gói fasttrack bỏ qua routing mark và có thể đi ra qua sai WAN.
FastTrack is still on: fasttracked packe.ru: FastTrack всё ещё включён: ускоренные пакеты пропускают метки маршрутизации и могут уйти через не тот WAN.
FastTrack is still on: fasttracked packe.pl: FastTrack jest nadal włączony: pakiety objęte fasttrack omijają znaczniki routingu i mogą wyjść przez niewłaściwy WAN.
FastTrack is still on: fasttracked packe.hi: FastTrack अब भी चालू है: फ़ास्टट्रैक पैकेट रूटिंग मार्क को छोड़ देते हैं और गलत WAN से बाहर जा सकते हैं।

Each check host is reachable only throug.es: Cada host de verificación solo es accesible por su propia WAN (las reglas output drop lo imponen). Elige hosts que no necesites para otra cosa y que respondan ping de forma confiable.
Each check host is reachable only throug.pt-BR: Cada host de verificação só é alcançável pela sua própria WAN (as regras de output drop garantem isso). Escolha hosts de que você não precise para outra coisa e que respondam a ping de forma confiável.
Each check host is reachable only throug.fr: Chaque hôte de test n'est joignable que par son propre WAN (les règles output drop l'imposent). Choisissez des hôtes dont vous n'avez pas besoin par ailleurs et qui répondent de façon fiable au ping.
Each check host is reachable only throug.de: Jeder Check-Host ist nur über sein eigenes WAN erreichbar (die Output-Drop-Regeln erzwingen das). Wählen Sie Hosts, die Sie sonst nicht brauchen und die zuverlässig auf Ping antworten.
Each check host is reachable only throug.id: Setiap host pengecekan hanya bisa dijangkau lewat WAN-nya sendiri (aturan output drop yang menegakkannya). Pilih host yang tidak Anda perlukan untuk hal lain, dan yang andal membalas ping.
Each check host is reachable only throug.it: Ogni host di verifica è raggiungibile solo attraverso la propria WAN (lo impongono le regole drop in output). Scegli host che non ti servono per altro e che rispondano sempre al ping.
Each check host is reachable only throug.tr: Her kontrol ana makinesine yalnızca kendi WAN'ı üzerinden ulaşılabilir (output drop kuralları bunu zorunlu kılar). Başka bir işiniz olmayan ve ping'e güvenilir biçimde yanıt veren ana makineler seçin.
Each check host is reachable only throug.vi: Mỗi máy chủ kiểm tra chỉ truy cập được qua WAN riêng của nó (các quy tắc output drop đảm bảo điều đó). Hãy chọn máy chủ mà bạn không cần dùng vào việc khác và luôn phản hồi ping ổn định.
Each check host is reachable only throug.ru: Каждый узел для проверки доступен только через свой WAN (это обеспечивают правила output drop). Выбирайте узлы, которые вам больше не нужны и которые стабильно отвечают на ping.
Each check host is reachable only throug.pl: Każdy host kontrolny jest osiągalny tylko przez swój WAN (wymuszają to reguły output drop). Wybierz hosty, których nie potrzebujesz do niczego innego i które niezawodnie odpowiadają na ping.
Each check host is reachable only throug.hi: हर चेक होस्ट सिर्फ़ अपने WAN से पहुँचा जा सकता है (output drop रूल यही लागू करते हैं)। ऐसे होस्ट चुनें जिनकी आपको और ज़रूरत न हो, और जो ping का भरोसेमंद जवाब दें।

both-addresses-and-ports spreads load be.es: both-addresses-and-ports reparte mejor la carga, pero las conexiones de un cliente al mismo sitio pueden salir por WAN distintas, lo que rompe los sitios que atan un inicio de sesión a la dirección IP.
both-addresses-and-ports spreads load be.pt-BR: O both-addresses-and-ports distribui melhor a carga, mas as conexões de um cliente ao mesmo site podem sair por WANs diferentes, o que quebra sites que amarram um login ao endereço IP.
both-addresses-and-ports spreads load be.fr: both-addresses-and-ports répartit le mieux la charge, mais les connexions d'un même client vers un même site peuvent sortir par des WAN différents, ce qui casse les sites qui lient une session à l'adresse IP.
both-addresses-and-ports spreads load be.de: both-addresses-and-ports verteilt die Last am besten, aber die Verbindungen eines Clients zur selben Seite können über verschiedene WANs hinausgehen, was Seiten stört, die eine Anmeldung an die IP-Adresse binden.
both-addresses-and-ports spreads load be.id: both-addresses-and-ports menyebarkan beban paling baik, tetapi koneksi satu klien ke situs yang sama bisa keluar lewat WAN berbeda, yang merusak situs yang mengikat login ke alamat IP.
both-addresses-and-ports spreads load be.it: both-addresses-and-ports distribuisce meglio il carico, ma le connessioni di un client verso lo stesso sito possono uscire da WAN diverse, e questo blocca i siti che legano un login all'indirizzo IP.
both-addresses-and-ports spreads load be.tr: both-addresses-and-ports yükü en iyi dağıtır, ancak bir istemcinin aynı siteye açtığı bağlantılar farklı WAN'lardan çıkabilir; bu da oturumu IP adresine bağlayan siteleri bozar.
both-addresses-and-ports spreads load be.vi: both-addresses-and-ports phân tải tốt nhất, nhưng các kết nối của một máy khách đến cùng một trang có thể đi ra qua các WAN khác nhau, làm hỏng những trang gắn phiên đăng nhập với địa chỉ IP.
both-addresses-and-ports spreads load be.ru: both-addresses-and-ports распределяет нагрузку лучше всего, но соединения одного клиента с одним сайтом могут уходить через разные WAN, из-за чего перестают работать сайты, привязывающие вход к IP-адресу.
both-addresses-and-ports spreads load be.pl: both-addresses-and-ports rozkłada obciążenie najlepiej, ale połączenia jednego klienta z tą samą witryną mogą wychodzić przez różne WAN-y, co psuje działanie witryn wiążących logowanie z adresem IP.
both-addresses-and-ports spreads load be.hi: both-addresses-and-ports लोड को सबसे अच्छा बाँटता है, लेकिन एक क्लाइंट के एक ही साइट के कनेक्शन अलग-अलग WAN से जा सकते हैं, जिससे वे साइटें खराब हो जाती हैं जो लॉगिन को IP एड्रेस से जोड़ती हैं।

both-addresses keeps every connection be.es: both-addresses mantiene todas las conexiones entre un cliente y un servidor en la misma WAN, lo que mantiene funcionando los inicios de sesión y las sesiones bancarias.
both-addresses keeps every connection be.pt-BR: O both-addresses mantém todas as conexões entre um cliente e um servidor na mesma WAN, o que mantém funcionando logins e sessões bancárias.
both-addresses keeps every connection be.fr: both-addresses garde toutes les connexions entre un client et un serveur sur le même WAN, ce qui préserve le bon fonctionnement des sessions de connexion et bancaires.
both-addresses keeps every connection be.de: both-addresses hält alle Verbindungen zwischen einem Client und einem Server auf demselben WAN, wodurch Anmeldungen und Banking-Sitzungen funktionieren.
both-addresses keeps every connection be.id: both-addresses menjaga semua koneksi antara satu klien dan satu server tetap di WAN yang sama, sehingga login dan sesi perbankan tetap berfungsi.
both-addresses keeps every connection be.it: both-addresses mantiene tutte le connessioni tra un client e un server sulla stessa WAN, così login e sessioni bancarie continuano a funzionare.
both-addresses keeps every connection be.tr: both-addresses, bir istemci ile bir sunucu arasındaki tüm bağlantıları aynı WAN üzerinde tutar; bu da oturum açma ve bankacılık oturumlarının çalışmasını sağlar.
both-addresses keeps every connection be.vi: both-addresses giữ mọi kết nối giữa một máy khách và một máy chủ trên cùng một WAN, nhờ đó phiên đăng nhập và giao dịch ngân hàng vẫn hoạt động.
both-addresses keeps every connection be.ru: both-addresses оставляет все соединения между одним клиентом и одним сервером на одном WAN, поэтому входы в аккаунты и банковские сессии продолжают работать.
both-addresses keeps every connection be.pl: both-addresses utrzymuje wszystkie połączenia między jednym klientem a jednym serwerem na tym samym WAN, dzięki czemu logowanie i sesje bankowe działają prawidłowo.
both-addresses keeps every connection be.hi: both-addresses एक क्लाइंट और एक सर्वर के बीच के सभी कनेक्शन एक ही WAN पर रखता है, जिससे लॉगिन और बैंकिंग सेशन चलते रहते हैं।

A gateway given as an interface name onl.es: Un gateway indicado como nombre de interfaz solo funciona en enlaces punto a punto como PPPoE o LTE. Una WAN con DHCP necesita la IP de su gateway, que cambia si el ISP la cambia.
A gateway given as an interface name onl.pt-BR: Um gateway informado como nome de interface só funciona para enlaces ponto a ponto como PPPoE ou LTE. Uma WAN com DHCP precisa do IP do gateway, e ele muda se o provedor o mudar.
A gateway given as an interface name onl.fr: Une passerelle donnée sous forme de nom d'interface ne fonctionne que pour des liaisons point à point comme PPPoE ou LTE. Un WAN en DHCP exige l'IP de sa passerelle, qui change si le FAI la change.
A gateway given as an interface name onl.de: Ein als Interface-Name angegebenes Gateway funktioniert nur bei Punkt-zu-Punkt-Verbindungen wie PPPoE oder LTE. Ein DHCP-WAN braucht seine Gateway-IP, und die ändert sich, wenn der Provider sie ändert.
A gateway given as an interface name onl.id: Gateway yang diberikan sebagai nama interface hanya berfungsi untuk link point-to-point seperti PPPoE atau LTE. WAN DHCP memerlukan IP gateway-nya, dan itu berubah jika ISP mengubahnya.
A gateway given as an interface name onl.it: Un gateway indicato come nome di interfaccia funziona solo per collegamenti punto-punto come PPPoE o LTE. Una WAN DHCP richiede l'IP del gateway, che cambia se lo cambia il provider.
A gateway given as an interface name onl.tr: Arayüz adı olarak verilen ağ geçidi yalnızca PPPoE veya LTE gibi noktadan noktaya bağlantılarda çalışır. DHCP kullanan bir WAN için ağ geçidi IP'si gerekir ve bu, servis sağlayıcı değiştirirse değişir.
A gateway given as an interface name onl.vi: Gateway nhập dưới dạng tên giao diện chỉ hoạt động với liên kết điểm-điểm như PPPoE hoặc LTE. WAN dùng DHCP cần IP gateway, và IP này sẽ đổi nếu ISP thay đổi.
A gateway given as an interface name onl.ru: Шлюз, указанный как имя интерфейса, работает только для соединений «точка-точка», таких как PPPoE или LTE. Для WAN с DHCP нужен IP-адрес шлюза, и он меняется, если его меняет провайдер.
A gateway given as an interface name onl.pl: Brama podana jako nazwa interfejsu działa tylko dla łączy punkt-punkt, takich jak PPPoE lub LTE. WAN z DHCP wymaga adresu IP bramy, który zmienia się, gdy zmieni go dostawca internetu.
A gateway given as an interface name onl.hi: इंटरफ़ेस नाम के रूप में दिया गया गेटवे सिर्फ़ PPPoE या LTE जैसे पॉइंट-टू-पॉइंट लिंक पर काम करता है। DHCP वाले WAN को गेटवे IP चाहिए, और ISP के बदलने पर वह बदल जाता है।
